verdict.rationale: Porkbun's docs say each API key can be limited to specific source IPs (CIDR supported) and/or specific domains, so a leaked key only touches listed domains from expected networks. Account two-factor authentication exists, API keys work without disabling it, and a community user confirms protecting their account with a passkey. Missing for 10: detailed first-party documentation of 2FA methods (TOTP/WebAuthn specifics); evidence of permission or operation-level key scoping beyond per-domain restriction.
